name: controls
summary: The DEFAULT plugin UI (doc 37 tier-1): declare params once as a UI tree (tabs/sections of sliders/numpads/toggles/dropdowns/buttons/readouts) and get get_def/set_def/$schema/thread-safe access. Parasitic — a plain host member, no owner identity, no ABI surface.

native.delivery: header — a host member; host delegates get_def/set_def to it
native.status: IMPLEMENTED — test_controls (8 tests): schema tree emit, set_def clamp/enum-reject/absent-tolerant, button/readout unwritable, snapshot typing, set_def/snapshot concurrency

ui.delivery: TS module bundled into the webui at build time
ui.status: DESIGN ONLY — not written (webui build world). Landing route per doc 37 prior-art: JSON-Forms-style schema/uiSchema/tester-registry + Tweakpane blades as the widget layer + a custom touch numpad (host-owned IME).

notes.zeroCore: Rides get_def/set_def/exchange only — no new transport, no cap, no ABI change (doc 37 additive invariant).
notes.schemaSource: Static plugin.json OR native get_def emit; both produce the same $schema tree. This helper is the native-emit path.
notes.state: values→def (persisted); structure→$schema (declaration, $rev-versioned); view state (open tab / collapse / scroll)→browser-local, NOT in def.
